5.0.SP2.description: Indicates how long the order as specified in the side stays in effect. SideTimeInForce allows a two-sided cross order to specify order behavior separately for each side. Absence of this field indicates that TimeInForce <59> should be referenced. SideTimeInForce will override TimeInForce if both are provided.
